## What pattern should be added?

Describe the pattern clearly. What problem does it solve?

## Which project types does it apply to?

- [ ] web-api
- [ ] cli-tool
- [ ] kmp-library
- [ ] web-app
- [ ] mobile-app
- [ ] microservice
- [ ] all

## Language/ecosystem

Does this pattern apply universally, or to a specific language/framework?

## Why does this matter?

What happens if someone skips this pattern? (e.g., "without input validation, every endpoint is a SQL injection vector")

## Do you have an example?

Link to code, a real project using this pattern, or a writeup.

## Would you be willing to write this up as a PR?

- [ ] Yes
- [ ] I can help with review
- [ ] No, just suggesting
